Name: (CP) Buildings with access Wizard Book
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] allows you to change the appearance and other settings.[/size]

In order to appear on the Wizard's construction menu, you must have read the email sent to you when your Wizard friendship level reaches 5 or above.

[size=3]If you have any problems or requests, please go to the POSTS page.[/size]

[size=2]Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included.[/size]
